subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

You are requested to give me change for Rs.2000.

options.text: You should give me change for Rs.2000.
Are you giving me change for Rs.2000?
Please give me change for Rs.2000.
Can you give me change for Rs.2000?

solution:
The correct answer is **'****Please give me change for Rs.2000.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an **Imperative sentence** and in Passive Voice.
 
• The rule for changing an **Imperative sentence** from Passive voice to Active voice:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.​
 
• Always insert please if it is a requesting sentence.
 
 
• Example: *Please do me a favour tonight. *(Active Voice)

 * You are requested to do me a favour tonight.** *(Passive Voice)
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is 'Please give me change for Rs.2000.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, the sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
 
• Example: *He reads a novel. *(Active Voice)

 * A novel is read by him. *(Passive Voice)*​*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 

 
• दिया गया वाक्य एक Imperative sentence और Passive Voice में है।
 
• एक Imperative sentence को Passive voice to Active voice में बदलने का नियम:
 
 
• Object और Subject को एक दूसरे के साथ बदलें, यानी active sentence की object, passive voice का subject बन जाती है।
 
• अगर यह अनुरोध करने वाला वाक्य है तो Plaese हमेशा डालें।
 
 
• Example: *Please do me a favour tonight. *(Active Voice)
 
 
 
 

 * You are requested to do me a favour tonight.** *(Passive Voice)
